title: JUDGE
summary: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the Society of Libertus in his journey to explore Ning – The Third 3 days and 2 nights.

content.text: TodayTourist is pleased to accompany the Society of Libertus in his journey to explore Ning – The Third 3 days and 2 nights.

The trip was not just an opportunity for people to rest together, to enjoy the beauty of the blue sea, the golden sun, but also an opportunity to bind the village bond, share happy moments, and retain many memorable memories.
Thank you very much for your confidence in choosing TodayTourist as a companion on this journey.
In particular, thank you to HDV the City of DDV for the warm support, care of the crew and bring a safe, complete, laughing trip.
